header.semantics: authored ManT grammar contract; mandoc proves actual text/font/HEAD structure, not entry kinds
header.nativeHeadPolicy: HTML dt printer LF plus indentation is one HTML flow space; no authored hard-line case uses this field
header.ownerProofPolicy: Source-authored native definition HEAD or actual B/MR adjacent RS; validated empty PP may be absent from AST. Never inferred from EntryKind.
